ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Since the beginning of winter, haze weather has occurred many times in many places across the country, with visibility less than 100m. In such bad weather, two cars, Jia and Yi, are traveling in the same direction on a straight one-way road, with Yi in front and Jia behind. At a certain moment, the drivers of the two cars simultaneously heard the siren warning ahead that an accident had occurred, and simultaneously began to brake; as a result, the two cars collided. The figure shows the v-t graph of the two cars after braking when they just do not collide; from this it can be known.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The two cars must have collided at some moment within 20s after braking

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is the v-t graph of the two cars after braking, the vertical axis is velocity v/(m·s^-1), and the horizontal axis is time t/s. The velocity line of car Jia is labeled v甲, decreasing with uniform deceleration from an initial velocity of about 25 m/s, and reaching a velocity of 0 at about 25 s; the velocity line of car Yi is labeled v乙, decreasing with uniform deceleration from an initial velocity of about 15 m/s, and reaching a velocity of 0 at about 30 s. The two velocity graph lines intersect at t=20 s, indicating that within 0～20 s the velocity of car Jia is greater than that of car Yi, and after 20 s the velocity of car Jia is less than that of car Yi. Then reason: The question stem states that Yi is in front and Jia is behind, and the two cars travel in the same direction and brake at the same time. The change in the distance between the two cars depends on the relative velocity v甲-v乙: within 0～20 s, v甲>v乙, the rear car Jia is still approaching relative to the front car Yi, and the distance between the cars continuously decreases; at t=20 s the relative velocity becomes 0, and the distance between the cars decreases to the minimum; after 20 s, v甲<v乙, if they have not collided by then, car Yi will gradually move away from car Jia, the distance between the cars will no longer decrease but will increase, so a rear-end collision can no longer occur afterward. The question states that the two cars actually collided, so the collision must have occurred in the stage when the distance between the cars was still decreasing, that is, within 20 s after braking.
